Source: IBGE Produção Agrícola Municipal (SIDRA Tabela 5457, variable 8331,
área plantada ou destinada à colheita, four crops) and Pesquisa da Pecuária
Municipal (SIDRA Tabela 3939, variable 105, efetivo bovino), SIDRA agregados
API v3, queried 2026-10-09 (`_data/raw/ibge/sidra/sidra_5457_*.json`,
`sidra_3939_*.json`); IBGE Áreas Territoriais 2022
(`_data/raw/ibge/AR_BR_RG_UF_RGINT_MES_MIC_MUN_2022.xls`, sheet AR_BR_MUN_2022,
the pipeline's area from phase 2, step 2.7, D-2026-10-28-g) and, for the
vintage comparison of Q7, IBGE Áreas Territoriais 2025
(`AR_BR_RG_UF_RGINT_RGI_MUN_2025.xls`, sheet AR_BR_MUN_2025, the phase 1
area). Pipeline script: `_scripts/03-controls-agro.R`.
Interim outputs: `_data/interim/pam_ppm_munic_area_2022.rds`,
`pam_ppm_crop_areas_1988_2025.rds`, `pam_ppm_cattle_1974_2025.rds`,
`pam_ppm_weights_base_2000_2002.rds`.
Equivalence with the recovered panel is not checked here (the notebook never
reads `_data/reference/`); the `compare_outputs` report lives in the phase 1
script 03 commit message and in the decision entries it cites.

```{r setup}
#| include: false
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readxl)
})
options(width = 110)
```

```{r read}
source("_scripts/utils/read_sidra.R")
sidra_dir <- "_data/raw/ibge/sidra"
sidra <- function(pattern) {
  map_dfr(list.files(sidra_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE), read_sidra_json)
}
pam_raw <- map_dfr(c(soy = "soja", corn = "milho", rice = "arroz", cotton = "algodao"),
                   ~ sidra(paste0("^sidra_5457_areaplanted_", .x, "_")), .id = "crop")
ppm_raw <- sidra("^sidra_3939_bovino_")
areas_raw <- read_excel("_data/raw/ibge/AR_BR_RG_UF_RGINT_MES_MIC_MUN_2022.xls",
                        sheet = "AR_BR_MUN_2022", col_types = "text")
areas_2025 <- read_excel("_data/raw/ibge/AR_BR_RG_UF_RGINT_RGI_MUN_2025.xls",
                         sheet = "AR_BR_MUN_2025", col_types = "text")
munic_area <- read_rds("_data/interim/pam_ppm_munic_area_2022.rds")
crop_areas <- read_rds("_data/interim/pam_ppm_crop_areas_1988_2025.rds")
cattle <- read_rds("_data/interim/pam_ppm_cattle_1974_2025.rds")
weights <- read_rds("_data/interim/pam_ppm_weights_base_2000_2002.rds")
# Biome sample of script 01 (503 municipalities, Mojuí dos Campos included).
sample_geo <- read_rds("_data/interim/mapbiomas_deforestation_amz_1987_2023.rds") %>%
  distinct(geocode, municipality, state_abbreviation)
```

## Q1. What do the PAM extracts contain, and which municipalities are missing?

What is checked: files per crop, the category id behind each crop, the year
span, the number of series, the symbols served, and the municipalities of
Brazil (and of the biome sample) without a Tabela 5457 series.

```{r q1-shape}
pam_raw %>%
  group_by(crop, category_id, category) %>%
  summarise(series = n_distinct(geocode), years = paste(range(year), collapse = "-"),
            cells = n(), dash = sum(value == "-"), dots = sum(value == "..."),
            other = sum(!str_detect(value, "^[0-9]+$") & !value %in% c("-", "...")),
            .groups = "drop")
```

```{r q1-missing}
all_munic <- sidra("^sidra_5938_pib_2023_N6") %>% distinct(geocode, municipality)
all_munic %>% filter(!geocode %in% pam_raw$geocode)
```

```{r q1-dots-sample}
pam_raw %>%
  filter(geocode %in% sample_geo$geocode, value == "...", year %in% 2000:2020) %>%
  group_by(geocode, year) %>%
  summarise(crops = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(sample_geo, by = "geocode") %>%
  group_by(geocode, municipality, state_abbreviation) %>%
  summarise(years = paste(range(year), collapse = "-"), n_years = n(),
            all_four_crops = all(crops == 4), .groups = "drop")
```

**Finding.** Each crop has one series per municipality for 1988-2025, in
hectares, for 5,564 of the 5,570 municipalities; the categories are
40099 (algodão herbáceo), 40102 (arroz), 40122 (milho) and 40124 (soja).
The only symbols are "-" (the SIDRA zero) and "..." (not available). Seven
municipalities have no series at all: Santa Cruz do Arari (PA), in the biome
sample, and six urban municipalities of Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo. In the
sample, "..." always covers the four crops of a municipality-year at once:
the nine Mato Grosso municipalities installed after 2000 before their first
survey year (task 1.6), Mojuí dos Campos before 2013, one Mato Grosso
municipality in 2002, and six Pará municipalities (Belém and Marituba among
them) in scattered years between 2002 and 2020, where the survey did not
report them.
**Decision.** D-2026-10-10-g (symbol rule); D-2026-10-10-i (Santa Cruz do
Arari).
**Assertion.** `03-controls-agro.R`, raw-state block (category ids, year
set, 5,564 series, symbols, Santa Cruz do Arari absent).

## Q2. What do the PPM extracts contain?

```{r q2-shape}
ppm_raw %>%
  group_by(category_id, category) %>%
  summarise(series = n_distinct(geocode), years = paste(range(year), collapse = "-"),
            cells = n(), dash = sum(value == "-"), dots = sum(value == "..."),
            other = sum(!str_detect(value, "^[0-9]+$") & !value %in% c("-", "...")),
            .groups = "drop")
all_munic %>% filter(!geocode %in% ppm_raw$geocode)
ppm_raw %>%
  filter(geocode %in% sample_geo$geocode, value == "...", year %in% 2000:2020) %>%
  left_join(sample_geo, by = "geocode") %>%
  group_by(geocode, municipality.y, state_abbreviation) %>%
  summarise(years = paste(range(year), collapse = "-"), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
```

**Finding.** One bovine herd series per municipality for 1974-2025, in
heads, for 5,568 municipalities (three urban municipalities of RJ and SP
are absent; Santa Cruz do Arari is present). Symbols as in PAM. In the
sample, "..." occurs for the nine post-2000 Mato Grosso municipalities in
2000-2004 only.
**Decision.** D-2026-10-10-g.
**Assertion.** `03-controls-agro.R`, raw-state block (category 2670, year
set, 5,568 series, symbols).

## Q3. What does the areas workbook contain? (2022 release from phase 2, step 2.7)

What is checked: the column names IBGE ships, the rows that are not
municipalities, the grid vintage, the PAM/PPM municipalities without an
area, and the area of Santa Cruz do Arari. Until 2026-10-28 the pipeline
read the 2025 release; the finding records both.

```{r q3-layout}
names(areas_raw)
nrow(areas_raw)
areas_raw %>% filter(!str_detect(CD_MUN, "^[0-9]{7}$") %in% TRUE)
areas_raw %>% filter(str_detect(CD_MUN, "^[0-9]{7}$") %in% TRUE, !CD_MUN %in% all_munic$geocode)
areas_raw %>% filter(CD_MUN == "1506401")
setdiff(unique(c(pam_raw$geocode, ppm_raw$geocode)), areas_raw$CD_MUN)
areas_2025 %>% filter(CD_MUN == "5101837")
```

```{r q3-sample}
munic_area %>%
  inner_join(sample_geo, by = "geocode") %>%
  summarise(n = n(), min_km2 = min(munic_area_km2), median_km2 = median(munic_area_km2),
            max_km2 = max(munic_area_km2))
```

**Finding.** The 2022 workbook carries IBGE's own column names (`ID`,
`CD_MUN`, `AR_MUN_2022`), 5,572 coded rows and three trailing rows without
a code (two blank, one note saying the areas were computed from the
BR_Municipios_2022 file of the Malha Municipal Digital, the mesh MapBiomas
Collection 9 maps). The coded rows are the 2022 grid: the 5,570
municipalities of the 2022 census and the two operational areas of Lagoa
dos Patos and Lagoa Mirim (4300001, 4300002), which are not
municipalities. Santa Cruz do Arari has 1076.652 km², as in the 2025
release. Boa Esperança do Norte (MT, 5101837, installed 2025), which PAM
and PPM report, is the one surveyed municipality without a 2022 area; its
crop shares, cattle density and base-window weights are NA and it stays in
the interim files, outside the biome sample. Until 2026-10-28 the pipeline
read the 2025 release (5,573 coded rows plus two trailing rows: the same
grid plus Boa Esperança do Norte, with the hand-renamed `geocode` and
`Area km2` of the lost file replaced by IBGE's names), so the parents of
the split carried post-split areas in every year; Q7 compares the two
vintages.
**Decision.** D-2026-10-10-i (the area is stored for every municipality of
the grid, independently of PAM); D-2026-10-28-g (the 2022 release in all
years, superseding the vintage of D-2026-10-10-f).
**Assertion.** `03-controls-agro.R`, raw-state block (column names, 5,572
coded rows plus three, Boa Esperança do Norte the only PAM/PPM code without
an area, Santa Cruz do Arari present) and output block (5,570
municipalities; NA shares and density for Boa Esperança do Norte only).

## Q4. Are the shares, densities and base-window weights plausible in the sample?

What is checked: distributions in the sample for 2000-2020, shares above 1
(successive crops), and the municipalities whose 2000-2002 window has no
observed value.

```{r q4-dist}
crop_areas %>%
  filter(geocode %in% sample_geo$geocode, year %in% 2000:2020) %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("crop_"), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(n_na = sum(is.na(value)), p50 = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            p99 = quantile(value, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE), max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            above_1 = sum(value > 1, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
cattle %>%
  filter(geocode %in% sample_geo$geocode, year %in% 2000:2020) %>%
  summarise(n_na = sum(is.na(cattle_heads)), p50_heads = median(cattle_heads, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_heads = max(cattle_heads, na.rm = TRUE),
            p50_density = median(cattle_per_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_density = max(cattle_per_km2, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r q4-weights}
weights %>%
  inner_join(sample_geo, by = "geocode") %>%
  filter(if_any(c(starts_with("crop_w_"), cattle_weight), is.na)) %>%
  select(geocode, municipality, state_abbreviation, starts_with("crop_w_"), cattle_weight)
weights %>%
  filter(geocode %in% sample_geo$geocode) %>%
  summarise(across(c(starts_with("crop_w_"), cattle_weight),
                   list(zero = ~ sum(.x == 0, na.rm = TRUE), p50 = ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                        max = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("weight", "stat"), names_pattern = "(.*)_(zero|p50|max)$") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value)
```

**Finding.** Shares are small for most municipalities; where they exceed
1 it is the double-cropping signature IBGE documents (successive crops
are counted twice). Cattle densities reach a few hundred heads per km2.
The base window is empty for the municipalities installed after 2002
(Ipiranga do Norte and Itanhangá, MT: crop and cattle weights NA), for
Mojuí dos Campos (installed 2013) and for Santa Cruz do Arari (crop
weights NA, no PAM series; cattle weight present); the other post-2000 MT
municipalities have a window value because PAM and PPM report them from
2001.
**Decision.** D-2026-10-10-f (window 2000-2002, NA for an empty window).
**Assertion.** `03-controls-agro.R`, output block (shares and densities
non-negative, weights never NaN).

## Q5. What does the pipeline carry for Santa Cruz do Arari?

```{r q5-arari}
munic_area %>% filter(geocode == "1506401")
crop_areas %>% filter(geocode == "1506401") %>% nrow()
cattle %>% filter(geocode == "1506401", year %in% c(2000:2002, 2020))
weights %>% filter(geocode == "1506401")
```

**Finding.** The municipality has its area and its herd series, and no
crop series. The recovered panel had NA in every one of its area, crop
and price columns because the legacy script attached the area through the
PAM table and the cattle index through the crop index; the rebuilt scripts
store the area on its own and join the two indices in full, so the area
and the cattle index are restored while the crop columns stay NA.
**Decision.** D-2026-10-10-i.
**Assertion.** `03-controls-agro.R`, raw-state block (absent from PAM,
present in PPM and in the areas workbook).

## Q6. Do the SIDRA symbols follow the installation rule? (phase 2, step 2.7, 2026-10-28)

What is checked: for the ten municipalities installed after 2000, the
years PAM (soy) and PPM report as "..." against the installation year of
the lookup, and the first year with a reported value (a number or "-");
the "..." cells of the sample outside that set; the "-" cells (task 1.8;
D-2026-10-28-d).

```{r q6-symbols}
post2000 <- read_csv("_data/aux/munic_post2000.csv",
                     col_types = cols(.default = col_character(), install_year = col_integer()))
# read_sidra_json carries its own municipality name: keep the keys and the symbol.
window <- function(d) d %>%
  filter(geocode %in% sample_geo$geocode, year %in% 2000:2020) %>%
  select(geocode, year, value)
symbol_rule <- function(d, label) {
  d %>%
    inner_join(post2000 %>% select(geocode, municipality, install_year), by = "geocode") %>%
    group_by(municipality, install_year) %>%
    summarise(dots = paste(range(year[value == "..."]), collapse = "-"),
              first_reported = min(year[value != "..."]),
              dash_or_number_before = sum(value != "..." & year < install_year),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(source = label)
}
bind_rows(symbol_rule(window(pam_raw %>% filter(crop == "soy")), "PAM soy"),
          symbol_rule(window(ppm_raw), "PPM")) %>%
  arrange(source, municipality)
window(pam_raw %>% filter(crop == "soy")) %>%
  filter(value == "...", !geocode %in% post2000$geocode) %>%
  left_join(sample_geo, by = "geocode") %>%
  group_by(municipality, state_abbreviation) %>%
  summarise(years = paste(year, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop")
window(ppm_raw) %>% summarise(dash = sum(value == "-"), dots = sum(value == "..."),
                              dots_outside_lookup = sum(value == "..." & !geocode %in% post2000$geocode))
```

**Finding.** For the ten lookup municipalities "..." covers exactly the
years before installation and the first reported value (a number, or "-"
where no soy was planted) appears in the installation year, in both
surveys; nothing is reported before it. The
remaining "..." cells of PAM are six Pará municipalities (Afuá,
Ananindeua, Belém, Benevides, Chaves, Marituba) and Gaúcha do Norte (MT,
2002) in scattered years, where the survey did not report the
municipality; PPM has no "..." outside the lookup set. The symbol rule
of D-2026-10-10-g ("-" zero, "..." NA) stands, and NA before
installation is a property of every source, asserted in script 04 against
the lookup.
**Decision.** D-2026-10-28-d.
**Assertion.** `04-panel-assemble.R`, output block (NA before the
installation year and observed from it in crops, cattle, employment,
population and GDP).

## Q7. Which area vintage sits on the MapBiomas mesh? (phase 2, step 2.7, 2026-10-28)

What is checked: the total area MapBiomas Collection 9 maps for each
municipality of the biome sample (all transition classes summed, 2023)
against the 2022 and the 2025 IBGE areas; the municipalities where the two
releases differ; the three municipalities of the Boa Esperança do Norte
split.

```{r q7-vintage}
mapped_total <- read_excel("_data/raw/mapbiomas/mapbiomas_munic.xlsx",
                           sheet = "DEF_SECVEG") %>%
  mutate(geocode = as.character(geocode)) %>%
  filter(geocode %in% sample_geo$geocode) %>%
  group_by(geocode) %>%
  summarise(mapped_total_km2 = sum(`2023`) / 100, .groups = "drop")
vintages <- mapped_total %>%
  left_join(rename(munic_area, area_2022 = munic_area_km2), by = "geocode") %>%
  left_join(areas_2025 %>%
              filter(str_detect(CD_MUN, "^[0-9]{7}$") %in% TRUE) %>%
              transmute(geocode = CD_MUN, area_2025 = as.numeric(AR_MUN_2025)),
            by = "geocode") %>%
  mutate(ratio_2022 = mapped_total_km2 / area_2022,
         ratio_2025 = mapped_total_km2 / area_2025)
vintages %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            within_1pct_2022 = sum(abs(ratio_2022 - 1) <= 0.01),
            within_1pct_2025 = sum(abs(ratio_2025 - 1) <= 0.01),
            over_2pct_2022 = sum(abs(ratio_2022 - 1) > 0.02),
            over_2pct_2025 = sum(abs(ratio_2025 - 1) > 0.02),
            releases_differ = sum(area_2022 != area_2025),
            differ_over_1pct = sum(abs(area_2022 / area_2025 - 1) > 0.01))
vintages %>%
  filter(abs(ratio_2022 - 1) > 0.02) %>%
  left_join(sample_geo, by = "geocode") %>%
  arrange(ratio_2022) %>%
  transmute(geocode, municipality, state_abbreviation,
            mapped_total_km2 = round(mapped_total_km2, 1),
            area_2022 = round(area_2022, 1), area_2025 = round(area_2025, 1),
            ratio_2022 = round(ratio_2022, 3), ratio_2025 = round(ratio_2025, 3))
vintages %>%
  filter(abs(area_2022 - area_2025) > 100) %>%
  left_join(sample_geo, by = "geocode") %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(area_2022 - area_2025))) %>%
  transmute(geocode, municipality, state_abbreviation,
            mapped_total_km2 = round(mapped_total_km2, 1),
            area_2022 = round(area_2022, 1), area_2025 = round(area_2025, 1),
            ratio_2022 = round(ratio_2022, 3), ratio_2025 = round(ratio_2025, 3))
```

**Finding.** The 2022 area lies within 1 percent of the mapped total for
486 of the 503 municipalities (485 of the 502 of the sample) against 459
(458) for the 2025 release, and differs from it by more than 2 percent in
7 against 20. The seven are coastal municipalities of Maranhão and Pará
(Raposa, Godofredo Viana, Porto Rico do Maranhão, São João de Pirabas,
Cururupu, Augusto Corrêa, Luís Domingues) where the mapped total falls
short of the area in both releases alike: MapBiomas' own coverage of the
coast, not the mesh. The two releases differ in 300 municipalities, 31 by
more than 1 percent. The large differences are the mesh: Nova Ubiratã
(12,460.7 km² in 2022 against 8,720.8 in 2025; ratio 1.000 against 1.429),
the Seringueiras-São Miguel do Guaporé (RO) boundary swap (3,773.5 and
7,460.1 km² in 2022; ratios 1.000 against 0.849 and 1.099) and boundary
revisions of 400-630 km² in Amazonas (Apuí, São Gabriel da Cachoeira,
Jutaí, Presidente Figueiredo, Borba), all of which the 2022 release puts
on the mapped mesh. With it no forest area exceeds the municipal area
(panel.qmd Q3).
**Decision.** D-2026-10-28-g.
**Assertion.** `03-controls-agro.R`, raw-state block (the 2022 file, sheet
and column; grid counts); `04-panel-assemble.R`, output block
(`N_FOREST_OVER_AREA_EXPECTED` = 0).
